input_messages.content: Hey, I just had a chat with Wanghao to prep the data pipeline for the OKR review. We need to make sure the infrastructure can support tracking that 45% Q3 retention target Boss Zhang finalized yesterday.
Good call getting ahead of that. Did Wanghao give you a specific estimate on the data volume we need to handle?

Oh? How did the conversation go? Is she supportive of the plan?
Yeah, mostly. She was pretty practical about it, asking exactly how much the gym membership costs per month. She also wondered if the gym membership had a hidden cancellation fee.
Fair questions! Gyms are notorious for those hidden fees. Did you manage to reassure her?
I did. She actually mentioned a colleague from her office who also just bought a gym membership, so it's been on her mind lately. But we had a good heart-to-heart after that.
That's good. It sounds like you two really got on the same page about your health goals.

input_messages.content: Hey, I need to vent a bit. I just told Liwei about the upcoming Shenzhen trip, and she became visibly upset when I announced it would overlap with our anniversary.
Oh man, I'm really sorry to hear that. That's a tough situation. How did the rest of the conversation go?

Yeah, she asked if the hotel for the Shenzhen trip was close to the city center. I really need to sort these bookings out and probably plan a massive makeup dinner for her.
A makeup dinner is a brilliant idea. Let me know if you need help finding a centrally located hotel or checking those Air China flights!
Hey, I need to update my schedule for this weekend. I just talked to Jiange about our workout plans because of the weekend dinner I have on Saturday.
Got it. What are we changing?
Well, Jiange asked if the weekend dinner was going to be at a fancy upscale restaurant. I told him it's that new steakhouse downtown.
Oh nice! Steakhouses are always a solid choice. Did that affect the workout schedule?
Yeah, he mentioned he actually loves the specific steakhouse chosen for the weekend dinner. But he also joked that he was totally offended he wasn't invited to the dinner!
Haha, fair enough. So when are you guys hitting the gym instead?
Since the dinner will wipe me out on Saturday, Jiange agreed to shift our Saturday workout to Sunday morning at 9 AM.
